scope: Preliminary read-only URL and address policy; full transport/protocol implementation not yet reviewed

source.transform: Node stripTypeScriptTypes mode transform; isolated reviewer snapshot only

independentAddressOracle.source: Provided IANA registry CSVs parsed independently with Python ipaddress, plus multicast and Azure platform exclusions; boundary and fixed-seed canonical-address vectors.

conclusion: No missing IANA deny range or reachable raw-URL canonicalization bypass was identified. One plain-address strictness gap and one overbroad source/design claim should be corrected before final review.

observations.classification: Defensive input-validation inconsistency; no reachable URL-path SSRF demonstrated
observations.counterevidence: admitPublicEndpoint rejects literal and percent-encoded zone delimiters before URL parsing; ordinary DNS AAAA wire records do not carry interface zone identifiers.
observations.recommendation: Reject scoped address text in the exported classifier before family/range checks; add a global-unicast-zone negative case to ensure the plain-address contract is consistent.

observations.location: Source comment in isPublicEndpointAddress and the design note claiming all NAT64 transition paths are blocked
observations.detail: RFC6052 permits organization-specific translation prefixes, including globally addressed prefixes serving non-global IPv4. The classifier blocks mapped and known IANA transition allocations, not every locally configured translator.
observations.recommendation: Narrow wording to known mapped/special-purpose transition prefixes and retain the explicit routing-table and local-network trust limitation.

reviewReasoning: Raw URL syntax is checked before WHATWG normalization, rejecting ambiguous whitespace/control, credentials, encoded input, queries, fragments, backslashes, dot path segments and alternate numeric IPv4 spellings.
Normalized DNS hostnames must match the validated raw lowercase hostname. IPv6 literals are parsed as actual IPv6 and range checked after canonicalization.

IPv4 and IPv6 range membership uses separate BlockLists. The current supplied IANA special-purpose allocations are completely excluded by explicit IPv4 blocks or the IPv6 global-unicast envelope with listed exceptions.
Publicly reachable special-purpose exceptions are intentionally denied; eligibility is not proof that an address is allocated, routed, trusted or a compatible MCP server.
URL-only preview must continue to report no network/protocol/authentication/routing verification. DNS pinning, proxy and TLS controls are not established by this file alone.
pendingFinalReview: All DNS answers and family validation before socket creation; immutable pinned lookup with no fallback; actual transport uses that pin for every phase.
Private HTTPS agent with explicit certificate verification and original endpoint identity; proxy environment cannot reroute the owned connection.
Bounded protocol response processing, cancellation and session cleanup; no credentials or remote state-store access.
No automatic protocol fallback, discovered endpoint adoption, redirects or session replay beyond the selected bounded mode.
